reviews.feedback: This does well to use Bootstrap and use Set-BuildEnvironment. `Import-Module PowerShellBuild -Force` should not be in the psakeFile. All tasks available "FromModule" show up when psake parses the psakeFile.ps1. So you wouldn't only need a `task default -depends Test`  and `task Test    -FromModule PowerShellBuild`

build.ps1 look good. It uses backticks which are not considered best practice, but it's a style nit.
psakefile.sp1: `Invoke-PSBTask` and `Set-PSBDefault` are not a commands and this would not work. The comments are nice, but they could also just use the description.
Response was mostly good. Not accurate about Build block.

ci.yml: `branches: ['**']` is probably not the best way for github. We may have just seen what the default branch or asked. It also has a publish test.
We do not need to `Import-Module PowerShellBuild` in the psakeFile.ps1. FromModule will load it.

```
branches:
      - '**'
```
Is not a good way to write this.
